description: This PHP class defines a Rule object used for validation purposes within the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates a rule class name, constructor parameters, and an optional message, providing getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: Rule
classes.description: A class representing a validation rule with associated class name, constructor parameters, and an optional message.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Rule instance with a class name, optional constructor parameters, and an optional message.

methods.name: getRuleClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the rule.

methods.name: setRuleClass
methods.description: Sets the class name of the rule.

methods.name: getRuleConstructorParams
methods.description: Returns the constructor parameters for the rule class.

methods.name: setRuleConstructorParams
methods.description: Sets the constructor parameters for the rule class.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the validation message associated with the rule, if any.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets the validation message for the rule.
